official_consumption.loader: code/fake_quant/main.py (--EBSS_calib --calib_path): reads the FIRST args.nsamples (default 128) JSONL lines, DataLoader(batch_size=1, shuffle=True)
official_consumption.tokenization: code/fake_quant/gptq_utils.py gptq_fwrd: the branch that handles text records (`if args.llmqat_calib`) tokenizes with truncation at model.seqlen = 2048, padding=True, then F.pad(..., value 0) to 2048 tokens and calls model(input_ids) with no attention mask; `--llmqat_calib` is not defined in the released argument parser (utils.py), so the released EBSS path is not runnable as published

authors_descriptions.rebuttal_tables: Tables_for_R2/R3/R4*.md: 'MoEQuant generates 128 sequences of 512 length' (time-cost tables); Table R4 'snapshot of generated samples by Qwen-MoE-14B' begins '! ### GMAT Club Daily Prep ...' (record 0 of EBSS_qwen.jsonl begins '! A A. 1 B. 2 C. 3 D. 4 ... ### GMAT Club Daily Prep ...'); EBSS generation time 'Qwen-MoE-14B 18 mins' (A800, Table R6)
authors_descriptions.paper: ICML 2025 (PMLR 267:8245-8260; text read from arXiv 2505.03804 HTML, the PMLR PDF could not be parsed): Sec. 4.2 EBSS = beam-like search keeping w branches scored by cumulative log-probability and the per-layer SD of expert usage (tau = 1.2, w = 4); 'Qwen-MoE-14B' cites huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B; the number and length of EBSS sequences are not stated; reported Qwen results combine EBSS with AGQ and QuaRot-style Hadamard rotation; no EBSS generation time in the paper

generating_checkpoint: UNDOCUMENTED for this artifact: no metadata in the file; the paper evaluates Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B (base) and also a Chat variant elsewhere; the repo ships a 'qwen_moe_14b_chat' model directory and lists both base and chat local paths
generation_procedure: consistent with one self-generated continuation per start token: records 0-93 begin exactly with the text of vocabulary token id i (single-byte tokens); later records begin with a lone byte that decodes to U+FFFD or merges with the next bytes, so the seed token cannot be verified from text for them (official_dataset_audit.json); length up to ~2048 tokens; search / sampling settings for this file are not documented
raw_file_unchanged: the local copy is the byte-exact official blob; it is never edited
